name: Discord
description: Discord messaging integration - send and receive messages via Discord bot
author: Dpro Bot Team

settingsUI.title: Discord Bot Configuration
settingsUI.description: Manage this channel at /dashboard/channels/discord. Enable the extension and restart the backend before configuration.

fields.name: bot_token
fields.label: Bot Token
fields.helpText: Get this from Discord Developer Portal → Bot → Token

fields.name: client_id
fields.label: Client ID
fields.helpText: Found in Discord Developer Portal → OAuth2 → Client ID

fields.name: guild_id
fields.label: Guild ID (Optional)
fields.helpText: Right-click your server → Copy ID (enable Developer Mode first)

fields.name: allowed_users
fields.label: Allowed Sender IDs
fields.helpText: Comma-separated IDs. An empty list blocks incoming messages.

fields.name: allowed_channels
fields.label: Allowed Channel IDs
fields.helpText: Comma-separated channel IDs. An empty list blocks incoming messages.
